funding_opportunities.program_name: 令和8年度 脱炭素技術等による工場・事業場の省CO2化加速事業（SHIFT事業）三次公募
funding_opportunities.agency: 環境省 / 温室効果ガス審査協会
funding_opportunities.subsidy_rate_text: 省CO2型システム改修: 1/3以内; DX型: 3/4以内
funding_opportunities.cap_text: 改修: 原則1億円、4,000t-CO2/年以上削減の場合5億円; DX型: 200万円
funding_opportunities.eligibility_summary: Private operators undertaking qualifying CO2-reducing system retrofit or DX-based operational improvement. Exact applicant, equipment-owner, site, and emissions-baseline requirements must be checked against the call documents.
funding_opportunities.yumori_relevance: HIGH for heat recovery, electrification, integrated hot-water/HVAC/thermal retrofit; indirect for GPU compute hardware itself.
funding_opportunities.blockers_or_gates: Simple efficiency-only upgrades to specified steam/HVAC/hot-water/furnace/CGS systems are excluded; qualifying CO2 reduction and detailed application evidence are required.

funding_opportunities.program_name: 福井県成長産業立地促進補助金（令和8年7月～）
funding_opportunities.subsidy_rate_text: AI型データセンター: 20%; 研究開発・本社機能（単独）: 25%; other add-ons may apply subject to requirements.
funding_opportunities.cap_text: AI型データセンター: 新設6億円 / 増設3億円, 総交付限度額30億円. Research/head-office track has separate caps.
funding_opportunities.eligibility_summary: AI data center category requires fixed-asset investment of at least 100億円 and a constructed data-center building; container data centers are excluded. Employment, wage, operating-history and profitability requirements also apply to the broader program.
funding_opportunities.yumori_relevance: MEDIUM/HIGH for later-scale expansion or a qualifying R&D/head-office structure; current 1 MW Phase-1 scenario is below the AI-data-center 100億円 investment threshold.
funding_opportunities.blockers_or_gates: Current Phase-1 scale does not satisfy the AI DC investment threshold; existing-building reuse and entity operating-history requirements require direct prefectural confirmation.

funding_opportunities.program_name: 福井市 企業立地助成金
funding_opportunities.agency: 福井市 商工労働部 企業立地推進課
funding_opportunities.subsidy_rate_text: Varies by facility/investment category; verify against current ordinance and R8 support materials.
funding_opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supports qualifying new or expanded business facilities and related investment in Fukui City. Designation application must be made before construction work begins.
funding_opportunities.yumori_relevance: HIGH enough to require direct City feasibility consultation before any construction/contract commitment.
funding_opportunities.blockers_or_gates: Program category, reuse of an existing public asset, applicant entity, eligible assets, employment requirements, and stacking with national/prefectural support require formal confirmation.

funding_opportunities.program_name: GX地域共創補助金2026 — データセンター設備投資型
funding_opportunities.agency: 経済産業省 / GX地域共創補助金事務局
funding_opportunities.subsidy_rate_text: Up to 1/2, with support intensity determined by location, power sourcing linkage, and power-source type; large-enterprise rates may be lower under the detailed table.
funding_opportunities.cap_text: Up to 250億円 for qualifying patterns; lower caps apply to other support-intensity patterns.
funding_opportunities.eligibility_summary: Data-center investment contributing to Japan's compute competitiveness, using decarbonized power and contributing to the power-source region. First call closed; second call is planned for mid-October through late November 2026.
funding_opportunities.yumori_relevance: STRATEGIC. Fukui City appears in the GX strategy-area decarbonized-power utilization list, but YUMORI scale, new-site/investment requirements, power sourcing, and minimum investment thresholds require formal eligibility confirmation.
funding_opportunities.blockers_or_gates: Large CAPEX and decarbonized-power conditions; first call already closed. Treat the planned second call as a watch item until final application dates/guidelines are published.
